Publication statement: [Wuchang] : Hubei guan shu ju, Qing Tongzhi 9 nian [1870]
Shows coastal area from Jiangsu Province to Hainan Island, including Taiwan.

Wood block print. Relief shown pictorially. Shows coastal area from Jiangsu Province to Hainan Island, including Taiwan. Scale ca. 1:4,000,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Previous call number: G7820 1864 .H8 Vault AACR2
